prereg.tau_justification: 0.10 energy units = 0.2 kT. (i) above the reference's own route disagreement (0.042) and its F' SE (0.04), so it is resolvable; (ii) ABF's windowed L2 error at T = 40 on this cell is 1.0-1.4 (v2), so a residual shared discretisation bias of 0.10 is <= 10 % of the quantity whose 10 % change the ABF-FR comparison seeks to resolve, and it enters both arms identically
prereg.ADMISSIBLE: A2 flat ensemble, production clip: U95(D_MF) <= 0.10 AND U95(D_density) <= 0.10; AND clip immaterial; AND zero non-finite walkers
prereg.MARGINAL: point estimates <= 0.10 but an upper bound > 0.10 (precision-limited: extend groups before deciding)
prereg.FAIL: either point estimate > 0.10, or any non-finite walker
prereg.clip_immaterial: fraction of clipped per-atom force evaluations <= 1e-5 AND debiased RMS between the clipped and unclipped mean-force-route profiles (paired runs) <= 0.05
prereg.selection_rule: the LARGEST ADMISSIBLE dt of the ladder (cheapest valid). Chosen from Stage A numerics only, never from any ABF or FR outcome. If none is ADMISSIBLE after the 6.25e-5 extension, no timestep is validated and all later comparisons are labelled exploratory.
